notes.title: 2/3rd's the way done
notes.notes:
Its been just about a year since the steam store page was made public.

Varkij: Dream and Nightmare is now 2/3rd's of the way done. Its been approximately four years since this game project has been started and it looks like it might be another 1-3 years until it gets released. There are currently 18 acts and 6 dream sequence acts to play though for play testers and patrons. The project is mostly being made by a single person which is why its taking so long.

I just thought I would share the news of how far along the project is so people can also know when to expect its release.
